topic: What MSB, BBK and RCB agree on: the core of every 72-hour plan

content.hook: Experts disagree on prepping? Not on these basics.

scenes.text: Experts disagree on prepping? Not on these *basics*.
*Water* first, then food that needs no cooking
A *family plan* for when phones go down

content.caption:
Preparedness basics: what Sweden's MSB, Germany's BBK and Poland's RCB agree on.

You don't need a bunker. You need the same short core list these agencies keep coming back to:

• Water and food that needs no cooking
• Medicine and basic first aid
• Some cash and your key documents
• A way to get information and stay in touch
• A family plan for when phones and internet are down
• A bag you can grab if you must leave

The goal is simple: manage the first 72 hours calmly, before help arrives. Then adjust it for your home, apartment or house.

Which is missing at home: water, cash or radio?
